description: Execute a SQL query on the database

format.description: Output format (default json). csv is far more compact for wide or long results: the first line is a JSON header with metadata, then the rows as CSV.

maxRows.description: Maximum rows to return across all result sets (default 1000, max 10000). When the cap is hit the query is cancelled on the server and the response starts with truncated: true. A truncated result is incomplete and the total row count is unknown: never report the cap as the number of rows. Prefer TOP, WHERE or aggregates over raising this.

name: query
